name: Aizawa Remon
source:
Remon is a young, new voice actress who's just starting to gain popularity.

She's been chosen to voice the main heroine in Flower's new title, but lately, she's been concerned about a lack of improvement in her acting.

[From [url=http://moroboshiyuumei.livejournal.com/28389.html]Moroboshi Yuumei's review[/url] and [url=http://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=4]MangaGamer[/url]]
